# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Age:** Early twenties  <sub>[v3 c25 P0](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0000), [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P6](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P5](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; later magazine story writer  <sub>[v3 c25 P0](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0000), [v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P6](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy Gardner is an exceptionally handsome and distinguished-looking young man with dark, melancholy, inscrutable eyes, a pleading, musical voice, and a fine, dark-eyed presence. He has a shapely chin and a magnetic, velvety smile that captivates those around him. He dresses impeccably and is noted for his stylish bearing.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 c25 P34](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0034), [v3 c26 P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 c27 P34](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0034)_

## Personality

Roy is polite, cultured, and romantic, often expressing his affections through poetic sentiments, gifts of flowers, and elegant compliments. He possesses a serious, somewhat somber demeanor, lacking a keen sense of humor, which can make his conversation seem uninteresting or overly formal at times. He is deeply devoted when pursuing an ideal or courting, though he is prone to falling passionately in love with his romantic ideals and eventually recovering when disappointed.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P5](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0005), [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Goals

- To win the affection of his ideal woman and marry her  <sub>[v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Roy Gardner entered Redmond College, but interrupted his studies after his Sophomore year to accompany his mother abroad for her health. Returning to Redmond after two years, he met Anne Shirley in the park during a autumn rainstorm when her umbrella turned inside out, rescuing her with his own umbrella. He began courting her attentively, sending her flowers and verse, and bringing her into his social circle. During Anne's Senior year, Roy proposed to her at the harbor pavilion in Kingsport, but she rejected his proposal upon realizing she did not truly love him. Heartbroken, he left Kingsport, but later recovered and married another woman, settling down into a happy life.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P20](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0020), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Born into a wealthy and prominent 'Bluenose' family in Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>
- Spent two years studying at Redmond College before taking two years off to travel in Europe with his mother  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>
- Had two previous romantic attachments before his courtship at Redmond  <sub>[v3 c39 P6](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0006)</sub>

## Quotes

> We are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten.  <sub>[v3 c25 P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)</sub>

> If I had my way I’d shut everything out of your life but happiness and pleasure, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c25 P22](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0022)</sub>

> You have ruined my life.  <sub>[v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)</sub>

> I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
